title: Snake wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#3ddc84'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#1fa35c'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='body2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#38c878'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#19924f'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- body coil -->
  <path d='M20 88 C 8 88, 8 72, 22 72 L 62 72 C 78 72, 78 56, 62 56 L 30 56 C 16 56, 16 40, 30 40 L 52 40'
        fill='none' stroke='url(#body)' stroke-width='13' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M20 88 C 8 88, 8 72, 22 72 L 62 72 C 78 72, 78 56, 62 56 L 30 56 C 16 56, 16 40, 30 40 L 52 40'
        fill='none' stroke='#a8f5c8' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- belly spots -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='72' r='3' fill='#c9ffe0'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='64' r='3' fill='#c9ffe0'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='56' r='3' fill='#c9ffe0'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='40' r='3' fill='#c9ffe0'/>

  <!-- neck rising -->
  <path d='M52 40 C 52 26, 60 22, 66 22 L 70 22' fill='none' stroke='url(#body2)' stroke-width='13' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='22' rx='15' ry='12' fill='#3ddc84'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='22' rx='15' ry='12' fill='none' stroke='#a8f5c8' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <rect x='56' y='16' width='13' height='10' rx='3' fill='#221133'/>
  <rect x='72' y='16' width='13' height='10' rx='3' fill='#221133'/>
  <rect x='68' y='19' width='5' height='2.5' fill='#221133'/>
  <rect x='56' y='16' width='13' height='10' rx='3' fill='#7a4dff' opacity='0.45'/>
  <rect x='72' y='16' width='13' height='10' rx='3' fill='#7a4dff' opacity='0.45'/>
  <line x1='58' y1='18' x2='63' y2='23' stroke='#c9a6ff' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <line x1='74' y1='18' x2='79' y2='23' stroke='#c9a6ff' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='20' x2='52' y2='19' stroke='#221133' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='85' y1='20' x2='89' y2='19' stroke='#221133' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- tongue -->
  <path d='M84 26 L 92 27 M84 26 L 92 25' stroke='#ff4d7a' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M82 26 L 85 26' stroke='#ff4d7a' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- smile hint -->
  <path d='M64 28 Q 70 31 76 28' fill='none' stroke='#b9f7d2' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
